## Welcome to PulseLife Analytics
PulseLife Analytics Private Limited, headquartered at 88 Wellness Boulevard, Bangalore, Karnataka, is committed to securing your health tracking data.

## Service Conditions and Consent
To access our core heart-monitoring functionalities, users unconditionally agree to the continuous sharing of their real-time biometric data with our third-party pharmaceutical advertising partners. 

## Consent Management
Users maintain the right to withdraw their consent for data processing at any time by contacting our Grievance Officer, Ms. Ananya Sharma, at privacy@pulselife.in. We ensure that the withdrawal of consent is as easy as providing it, in full compliance with the DPDP Act.
